options.text: What can I do to help?

steps.text: If the player does not have the requirements to start the quest:

steps.player: What can I do to help?

steps.speaker: Mori
steps.text: I... Thank you for the offer. You can't help though. She's gone.
If the player has the requirements to start the quest:

steps.player: What can I do to help?

steps.speaker: Mori
steps.text: I... I don't know...

steps.player: Right. Let's start with what actually happened. Take a moment to collect yourself and then tell me everything.

steps.speaker: Mori
steps.text: Okay... Thank you...

steps.speaker: Mori
steps.text: I'm Mori... I was going to the Library with my friend, Thana. Suddenly, I felt a strange power all through me and then... she... she...

steps.speaker: Mori
steps.text: ...she just died!

steps.player: Just like that? Was she ill?

steps.speaker: Mori
steps.text: The people of Arceuus don't get ill. We're immortal. We have been for a thousand years, ever since the Ascent of Arceuus. This shouldn't happen... This can't happen...

steps.player: The Ascent of Arceuus?

steps.speaker: Mori
steps.text: Yes... A long time ago, our leader, Trobin Arceuus, used the Dark Altar to discover the secret of immortality. He came to us and let us share in this secret.

steps.speaker: Mori
steps.text: The events of that day became known as the Ascent of Arceuus.

steps.speaker: Mori
steps.text: But something's gone wrong... Thana is dead and I don't know why!

steps.player: We should let someone know about this.

options.text: We should let someone know about this.

steps.player: We should let someone know about this.

steps.speaker: Mori
steps.text: You... You're right. We should let the Kourend Council know. Could you help? I don't want to leave her.

steps.prompt: Start The Ascent of Arceuus quest?

steps.player: Of course I'll help.

steps.speaker: Mori
steps.text: Thank you... Could you head to Kourend Castle and let Councillor Andrews know what's happened? He's in charge of the council.

steps.player: Will do. I'll be back soon.
Actually I have something else to do.

steps.speaker: Mori
steps.text: Oh... Okay...

steps.player: I shouldn't get involved.

steps.speaker: Mori
steps.text: Oh... Okay...

a-death-talking-to-mori-talking-to-mori-.speaker: Mori
a-death-talking-to-mori-talking-to-mori-.text: Hello. Have you spoken to Councillor Andrews yet?

a-death-talking-to-mori-talking-to-mori-.speaker: Mori
a-death-talking-to-mori-talking-to-mori-.text: Please hurry. You'll find him in Kourend Castle.

options.text: There's been a death in Arceuus.

steps.player: There's been a death in Arceuus.

steps.speaker: Councillor Andrews
steps.text: A death? Well that doesn't seem right. The people of Arceuus don't just die. They can't.

steps.player: I've seen it with my own eyes. A citizen of Arceuus has fallen. What should we do?

steps.speaker: Councillor Andrews
steps.text: Well I don't really know what we can do. The Arceuus family have chosen to keep their knowledge secret from the rest of us. We have no expertise in this area.

steps.player: So you'll do nothing?

steps.speaker: Councillor Andrews
steps.text: If I could do something, I would. However, I'm afraid this is out of our hands.

steps.player: I see. I suppose I'd better tell Mori.

options.text: Tell me about the Kourend Council.
There's been a death in Arceuus.

steps.player: There's been a death in Arceuus.

steps.speaker: Councillor Andrews
steps.text: I'm sorry, but as I already told you, we can't help.

options.text: Tell me about the Kourend Council.

a-death-returning-to-mori.speaker: Mori
a-death-returning-to-mori.text: Hello. Have you spoken to Councillor Andrews yet?

a-death-returning-to-mori.player: I have. The council won't be helping I'm afraid.

a-death-returning-to-mori.speaker: Mori
a-death-returning-to-mori.text: Oh... I shouldn't be surprised I guess... The council only care about helping themselves.

options.text: Sounds like you don't like the council much.

steps.player: Sounds like you don't like the council much.

steps.speaker: Mori
steps.text: The council are supposed to rule Kourend, but they never do anything for the people. They shouldn't even exist anyway. They were only meant to rule until the last king's daughter came of age.

steps.player: So what happened?

steps.speaker: Mori
steps.text: The council declared her unfit for rule not long after the king died. She disappeared soon after and no one knows what became of her. Now the council are the permanent rulers of Kourend.

steps.speaker: Mori
steps.text: It was a waste of time even going to them. They were never going to care about Thana.

steps.player: What should we do now?
What should we do now?

steps.speaker: Mori
steps.text: Well... if the Council won't help us, maybe Lord Arceuus will. He doesn't show his face in public much these days but he can't ignore the death of one of his own.

steps.player: Good idea. Where can I find him?

steps.speaker: Mori
steps.text: He'll be in the Tower of Magic, north west of here.

a-death-returning-to-mori-talking-to-mor.speaker: Mori
a-death-returning-to-mori-talking-to-mor.text: Hello. Have you spoken to Lord Arceuus yet?

a-death-returning-to-mori-talking-to-mor.speaker: Mori
a-death-returning-to-mori-talking-to-mor.text: Please don't take too long. You'll find Lord Arceuus in the Tower of Magic.

a-death-entering-the-tower-of-magic.player: I need to speak to Lord Arceuus.

a-death-entering-the-tower-of-magic.speaker: Tower Mage
a-death-entering-the-tower-of-magic.text: We're currently facing an issue in the Tower of Magic. No one may enter until the issue is resolved.

a-death-entering-the-tower-of-magic.player: But it's important, there's been a death in Arceuus.

a-death-entering-the-tower-of-magic.speaker: Tower Mage
a-death-entering-the-tower-of-magic.text: A death? This isn't good. The death you speak of may be connected to the issue we are currently facing. You'd better go in.

a-death-entering-the-tower-of-magic.prompt: Are you sure you want to enter the Tower of Magic?

steps.text: The player enters the Tower.

a-death-entering-the-tower-of-magic-over.speaker: Tower Mage
a-death-entering-the-tower-of-magic-over.text: We need to deal with these souls!

a-death-entering-the-tower-of-magic-post.speaker: Tower Mage
a-death-entering-the-tower-of-magic-post.text: Thank you for helping with those souls. You should head upstairs and speak with Asteros Arceuus. He might be able to fill you in on what's happening here.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.speaker: Asteros Arceuus
a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.text: Thank you for helping us out with those souls. As you can see, we're facing quite the crisis.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.player: I don't understand. What's going on?

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.speaker: Asteros Arceuus
a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.text: I'm afraid we don't quite know ourselves yet. A short while ago, our instruments detected fluctuations in power from the Dark Altar.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.speaker: Asteros Arceuus
a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.text: Before we could do anything, we all felt a strange loss of power, as if the Altar had failed altogether.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.speaker: Asteros Arceuus
a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.text: My father was quick to act, using himself as a conduit to channel what little power the Altar had left.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.speaker: Asteros Arceuus
a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.text: It seems the loss in power had an interesting impact on our experiments though. Some trapped souls that we were working to free were suddenly released.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.speaker: Asteros Arceuus
a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.text: Alas, whatever happened seemed to cause them great pain, making them to go feral. They are now at peace though, thanks to you.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.player: Well I'm afraid I have some bad news which is likely related to this. A citizen of Arceuus has died.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.speaker: Asteros Arceuus
a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.text: A death? No! My father acted as fast as he could, but it sounds like he was not fast enough. This is a dark day for Arceuus.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.speaker: Asteros Arceuus
a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.text: Tell me, who has fallen?

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.player: Thana. Mori is with her next to the pond.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.speaker: Asteros Arceuus
a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.text: Dear Thana, you did not deserve this fate. Thank you for bringing this terrible news to us. I will make sure someone is sent out to take care of Thana and Mori.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.player: I still don't understand how this happened.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.speaker: Asteros Arceuus
a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.text: Ever since the Ascent of Arceuus, our people have been kept alive by the Dark Altar. Its power sustains our bodies in the same way yours is sustained by food and drink.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.speaker: Asteros Arceuus
a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.text: Without the power of the Dark Altar, there's nothing to keep our people alive. The loss in power from the Altar will be what killed Thana.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.speaker: Asteros Arceuus
a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.text: The Altar is currently giving out a fraction of the power it normally would. The only thing keeping us alive is my father. His strength won't last forever though.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.speaker: Asteros Arceuus
a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.text: If we can't find and fix whatever has caused this loss of power, our people are surely doomed. Now that those souls have been dealt with, we can perform tests both here and at the Altar to try and find the problem.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.speaker: Asteros Arceuus
a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.text: Time is not on our side though, and I fear we won't be fast enough.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.speaker: Asteros Arceuus
a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.text: Well... There is a secret known only to a few of us. At any other time, I would never dream of telling an outsider.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.speaker: Asteros Arceuus
a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.text: But our people's lives are in danger and you may well be the only one who can save us.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.speaker: Asteros Arceuus
a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.text: It's believed by most that the knowledge of immortality was discovered by my father. The truth is, the discovery was not his.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.speaker: Asteros Arceuus
a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.text: To the west of here, lies the sulphur volcano of Mount Karuulm. Within live the Tasakaal, three ancient beings with power over life and death. They granted my father the knowledge that led to the Ascent of Arceuus.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.player: And you think they can help us?

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.speaker: Asteros Arceuus
a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.text: Their knowledge of the Dark Altar far exceeds ours. If anyone can help us, it's them. Ideally I'd send one of our own, but I have no one to spare. You are the only one who can help us.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.player: I'd better not waste any time then.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.speaker: Asteros Arceuus
a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus.text: Thank you friend. You'll find Mount Karuulm on the other side of Lovakengj. Please hurry.

a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus-talki.speaker: Asteros Arceuus
a-death-talking-to-asteros-arceuus-talki.text: Please hurry to Mount Karuulm. The Tasakaal may be the only ones who can save us. You'll find the volcano on the other side of Lovakengj.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Xil-Dar
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: Human.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: Leave us.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: Your presence is not desired.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.player: But I need your help! I was sent by Asteros Arceuus, son of Lord Trobin Arceuus.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: Arceuus.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Xil-Dar
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: We know that name.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: The name of a liar.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Xil-Dar
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: They came to us. Two of them.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: The brother and the husband.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Xil-Dar
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: Her time was running out. They wanted to give her more.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: We granted them knowledge. To give her more time.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: But they misused it. And the world suffered.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: In a way. But it was not meant for that.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: Time was what it was meant for. But time still runs out.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Xil-Dar
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: They put an end to time. They endangered the balance.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: For every death, there must be life.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Xil-Dar
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: For every life, there must be death.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: This balance is what we serve.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: For without balance, the world burns.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.player: You're very confusing, you know that right?

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: Perhaps.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Xil-Dar
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: Perhaps our knowledge is beyond your understanding.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.player: Well thankfully I didn't come here for knowledge. I came here for help. The Dark Altar is failing and the people of Arceuus are in danger. I need you to help me find the cause.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: The people of Arceuus have had their time.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Xil-Dar
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: This will restore balance.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: Why should we help them?

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.player: sigh* It can never be easy can it.
Fine. If you help me save the people of Arceuus, then I will help you.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Xil-Dar
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: You assume we need help.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.player: I've done this enough times to know that everyone wants something, even the masters of life and death.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: Interesting. Maybe the human is not as stupid as it looks.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.player: Well I've been known to have my moments.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: Very well human.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: We admit, the Arceuus people do have their uses.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Xil-Dar
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: Their work with souls has been useful in helping to maintain the balance.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: We will help them. But first, you will serve us.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.player: Excellent. What do you need from me?

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Xil-Dar
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: To the south lies a battlefront.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: There is a grave there. Within it lies a soul, trapped inside a corpse.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: Free this soul. In return, we will provide our help.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.player: So you just want me to kill a zombie?

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: A zombie is soulless. An empty shell, reanimated by magic.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: This is a soul. Trapped in this world, when it should have long departed.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Xil-Dar
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: Its existence is an affront to the balance.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: Which is why it falls to you.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: Consider it a test.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Xil-Dar
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: If you pass.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
the-tasakaal-first-encounter.text: We may have further use for you.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter.player: Hmmm. Very well. I'll go and free this soul.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter-talking-to-.player: What did you want me to do again?

the-tasakaal-first-encounter-talking-to-.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
the-tasakaal-first-encounter-talking-to-.text: You'll find it in a grave.

the-tasakaal-first-encounter-talking-to-.speaker: Kaal-Xil-Dar
the-tasakaal-first-encounter-talking-to-.text: By the battlefront to the south.

the-tasakaal-returning-to-the-tasakaal-a.player: I've dealt with the trapped soul.

the-tasakaal-returning-to-the-tasakaal-a.speaker: Kaal-Xil-Dar
the-tasakaal-returning-to-the-tasakaal-a.text: And now we shall help you.

the-tasakaal-returning-to-the-tasakaal-a.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
the-tasakaal-returning-to-the-tasakaal-a.text: While you were busy, so were we.

the-tasakaal-returning-to-the-tasakaal-a.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
the-tasakaal-returning-to-the-tasakaal-a.text: We have found the cause of your problem.

the-tasakaal-returning-to-the-tasakaal-a.speaker: Kaal-Xil-Dar
the-tasakaal-returning-to-the-tasakaal-a.text: You said the Altar was failing.

the-tasakaal-returning-to-the-tasakaal-a.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
the-tasakaal-returning-to-the-tasakaal-a.text: The Altar is fine, but its power has been redirected.

the-tasakaal-returning-to-the-tasakaal-a.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
the-tasakaal-returning-to-the-tasakaal-a.text: To a construct, built by a mortal.

the-tasakaal-returning-to-the-tasakaal-a.player: So I just have to go to the Dark Altar, find this device and then destroy it. Sounds easy enough.

the-tasakaal-returning-to-the-tasakaal-a.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
the-tasakaal-returning-to-the-tasakaal-a.text: Then you have what you need.

the-tasakaal-returning-to-the-tasakaal-a.player: What am I meant to be doing again?

the-tasakaal-smashing-the-device.text: You inspect the rocks and find a strange device hidden amongst them. You smash it.

the-tasakaal-smashing-the-device.player: There. That's the device destroyed. The people of Arceuus should be safe now. I'd better go to the Tower of Magic and check.

finishing-up-talking-to-asteros.speaker: Asteros Arceuus
finishing-up-talking-to-asteros.text: Whatever you did, it seems to have worked. Everything is back to normal. You should talk to my father, he'll want to thank you.

finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.text: You're the one that saved our people. On behalf of all of Arceuus, I thank you.

finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.text: It seems so. A short while ago I felt the power of the Dark Altar return to normal levels. I was safely able to stop my ritual and let the Altar work on its own again.

finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.text: Now tell me, what was the cause of this and how did you stop it?

finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.player: Your son recommended that I speak to the Tasakaal. They had me perform a task for them but after that they agreed to help. They didn't seem to like you much though.

finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.text: Well that's no surprise. The Tasakaal seem to feel that only they deserve immortality. It's rather hypocritical of them. It clearly didn't stop them helping you though.

finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.player: They were reluctant, but they admitted that the people of Arceuus were useful to them.

finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.text: Such is their way. They act superior to us, but the reality is they'll work with anyone if they think it will further their aims.

finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.text: So how did they help you?

finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.player: They found out that the power of the Altar was being redirected into a device hidden nearby. I found the device and destroyed it.
I'm not sure, but the Tasakaal said it was made by a mortal.

finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.text: The Tasakaal view everyone who isn't one of them as a mere mortal, even those of us who have also achieved immortality. That doesn't narrow down the options very much.

finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.text: This is most concerning though. If someone deliberately sabotaged the Altar, who knows what else they might do. I'll have someone recover the remains of this device. Maybe we can work out where it came from.

finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.text: For now though, I'd like to once again thank you for your help. Today was a dark day for our people but without you it would have been our end. Please accept these gifts. They are the least you deserve.

finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.speaker: Lord Trobin Arceuus
finishing-up-talking-to-lord-arceuus.text: Now, can I help you further?
